verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions mock or fake model providers, tool stubbing, or a unit-test harness for agents. Scorers and evals (mastra-docs-49, mastra-docs-7) grade real agent outputs. Studio (mastra-docs-50) is an interactive testing UI. Neither is unit testing with mocked models and tools. Mocking is a fair axis for an agent framework, so the lack of evidence makes this none, not na.
